content:
Pipelines that use the HTTP source plugin handle back pressure diﬀerently depending on which
pipeline component is congested:
• Buﬀers – When buﬀers are full, the pipeline starts returning HTTP status REQUEST_TIMEOUT
with error code 408 back to the source endpoint. As buﬀers are freed up, the pipeline starts
processing HTTP events again.
• Source threads – When all HTTP source threads are busy executing requests and the
unprocessed request queue size has exceeded the maximum allowed number of requests, the
pipeline starts to return HTTP status TOO_MANY_REQUESTS with error code 429 back to the
source endpoint. When the request queue drops below the maximum allowed queue size, the
pipeline starts processing requests again.
